# Where to Watch Extraordinary


by Angel | October 23, 2026


How far would you go to follow a calling you couldn’t ignore? In *Extraordinary* , one man’s incredible journey across America becomes a story about faith, perseverance, and the promises that hold a marriage together. Based on a true story, this inspiring film follows marathon runner David Horton as he takes on a 2,900-mile race after open-heart surgery.


[Watch Extraordinary now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/extraordinary)


### **A Race Against the Odds**


After open-heart surgery, David Horton believes his running days may be over. But rather than stepping away from the sport that has shaped his life, he feels called by God to inspire others one last time. His answer? A grueling 2,900-mile race across America.


The journey will push David to his limits, but the miles ahead hold a purpose beyond the finish line. As he meets people along the way, his determination becomes an opportunity to share hope and remind others not to give up.


### **A Marriage Tested by the Journey**


While David sets out on his cross-country adventure, his wife, Nancy, faces challenges of her own. Supporting a husband with such an ambitious goal isn’t always easy, especially when the journey affects their life together.


At its heart, *Extraordinary* is about more than one man’s endurance. It explores what it takes for a couple to keep choosing each other through uncertainty, communicate through difficult moments, and remember the commitment that brought them together. David’s race becomes a reminder that lasting love requires patience, understanding, and support from both sides.


### **Watch** ***Extraordinary*** **on Angel**


With an inspiring true story at its center, *Extraordinary* offers a heartfelt look at marriage, faith, and the determination to keep moving forward. David and Nancy’s journey shows that some of life’s biggest challenges aren’t overcome alone. They’re faced with love, honest communication, and a willingness to keep showing up for one another.


Ready for a story that will encourage you to hold on to what matters most?[Stream Extraordinary now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/extraordinary)
